description: Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs: main content only (no nav, footer, scripts, cookie banners), with headings, lists, links, images, tables and code blocks preserved. Optional maxChars (1,000-200,000, default 50,000). Fast (1-3 s). Free: 20 calls/day per user across free tools, no payment needed. Above that: $0.003 per call, with card credits (access_key) or x402.

access_key.description: Prepaid credit key (cs_live_...) bought by card at https://www.aypiai.online/credits. Works on every tool; each call deducts its price.

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value signed for the requirements returned by an unpaid call (USDC on Base, gasless). Omit on the first call to get the price and requirements.

name: page_markdown
title: Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs
